summary: @ornikar/eslint-config-babel preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: The package advertises itself as an ESLint Babel config (index.js is a 923-byte rule table) but ships an 11 KB obfuscated setup.mjs and a 727 KB obfuscated math_init.js unrelated to that purpose. package.json declares `"preinstall": "node setup.mjs"`, and setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime binary from the oven-sh/bun GitHub releases, chmods it 0o755, and invokes it via execFileSync against the sibling math_init.js. Both setup.mjs (hex-mangled identifiers `_0x488df8`, `_0x52943e`, string-key indirection) and math_init.js (single-line rotated string-array with char-code decoder, obfuscator.io signature) are obfuscated. Executing a 727 KB obfuscated blob via a freshly downloaded alternate language runtime at `npm install` time is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern, using the non-Node interpreter to evade Node-based scanners. Purpose/content mismatch, install-time auto-execution, and obfuscation of both the loader and the payload jointly establish an install-time RCE against the installer's host.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
